item.title: Why China Is Helping Egypt Build New Drones
item.description: Egypt is building a drone armada in response to what it views as aggressive actions from neighboring Israel—and it has sought China’s help to do it. The post Why China Is Helping Egypt Build New Drones appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How France Plans to Stop a Russian Attack on Its Satellite Ground Stations
item.description: France’s SkyFortress system is intended to provide redundancy on the ground, enabling individual ground stations to quickly take over satellite communications if others are put offline. The post How France Plans to Stop a Russian Attack on Its Satellite Ground Stations appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Greece Is Sending Its Tanks All the Way to France
item.description: Greece has one of NATO’s largest tank forces, although many of its vehicles date back to the Cold War and would be of limited use on a modern battlefield. The post Why Greece Is Sending Its Tanks All the Way to France appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How Are Modern Aircraft Wings Designed?
item.description: Today, aircraft wings are increasingly designed to prioritize stealth characteristics over raw speed—giving them a smooth, unbroken connection to the aircraft’s main fuselage. The post How Are Modern Aircraft Wings Designed? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Are All Modern Fighter Jets “Multirole” Aircraft?
item.description: As fighter jets have grown more and more expensive, pressure has mounted on modern air forces to enable those aircraft to carry out multiple distinct missions. The post Why Are All Modern Fighter Jets “Multirole” Aircraft? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: To Offset China, the US Must Engage with the Caspian Region
item.description: The Donald Trump administration’s recent slew of deals in Central Asia must be accompanied by the removal of congressional roadblocks to further regional cooperation. The post To Offset China, the US Must Engage with the Caspian Region appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Facing Sanctions, Putin’s Shadow Fleet Keeps Russia Afloat
item.description: Russia has used its Shadow Fleet to export seized Ukrainian grain, as well as oil. The post Facing Sanctions, Putin’s Shadow Fleet Keeps Russia Afloat appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Sorry, Russia: India Just Doesn’t Want Your Fifth-Gen Fighter
item.description: India won’t be “quitting” Russia anytime soon, as it still needs Russian military platforms, but New Delhi is all-in on developing indigenous platforms. The post Sorry, Russia: India Just Doesn’t Want Your Fifth-Gen Fighter appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: South Korean K2 Black Panther Tanks Are Heading to Peru
item.description: Though Korea and Peru are on opposite sides of the globe, they have a similar climate and geography, making the Black Panther easy to adapt for Peruvian conditions. The post South Korean K2 Black Panther Tanks Are Heading to Peru appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How Decades of Failed Governance Poisoned Iran’s Air
item.description: The human and economic costs of Iran’s poor air quality are an indictment of the Islamic Republic’s corrupt governance. The post How Decades of Failed Governance Poisoned Iran’s Air appeared first on The National Interest.
